step1_welcome: Welcome back! Now that you've mastered tasks, let's learn how to organize and manipulate windows like a pro!
step2_moveIcon: You can drag desktop icons anywhere to organize your space. Try moving this Practice Note to another spot!
step2_reminder: Click and hold the left mouse button on the icon to drag it.
step3_openWindow: Now, open the Practice Note by double-clicking on it.
step3_reminder: Remember: double-click quickly to open it.
step4_moveWindow: Windows can be moved anywhere on your screen! Drag the top title bar to move the window.
step4_reminder: Click on the top title bar and drag the window.
step5_resizeWindow: If you move your mouse to the window edges or corners, you can drag to make it bigger or smaller. Try resizing it!
step5_reminder: Drag from the corners or edges to resize the window.
step5_awesome: Awesome! You can resize any window to fit your needs.
step6_maximize: You can also make the window fill the whole screen! Click the Maximize button.
step6_maximizeReminder: Click the square Maximize button in the top-right.
step6_restore: Now click the button again to restore it to normal size.
step6_restoreReminder: Click the restore button in the top-right.
step7_minimize: To temporarily hide a window, click the Minimize button.
step7_taskbar: It hides right here on your taskbar! Click the icon to bring it back.
step7_taskbarReminder: Click the taskbar button to restore your window.
step8_close: When you are finished with a window, click the red X to close it.
step8_closeReminder: Click the red X to close the window.
step9_recycle: Finally, if you don't need a file anymore, you can throw it in the Recycle Bin. Drag the Practice Note there!
step9_recycleReminder: Drag the Practice Note icon over the Recycle Bin and drop it.
step9_congrats: Congratulations! You've mastered all desktop and window controls. Have fun exploring!
